accepted.quote: The so-called Mithraeum of the Seven Spheres is located in ancient Ostia near to the theater-cum-quadriporticus complex. The so-called Quattro tempietti screen it from the Decumanus Maximus. Representative point: longitude 12.290494, latitude 41.755778.
accepted.note: Near the theater and quadriporticus, screened from the Decumanus Maximus by the Quattro tempietti.
